title: One-step simulation under left-block embedding
statement: Let $k,l\in\mathbb N$, let $M$ have $k$ work tapes and states in $S$, and let $M'$ have $k+l$ work tapes and states in $S'$, both over Boolean symbols. Suppose $f:S\to S'$ and, for every state $q$, input symbol (possibly absent), and tuple of symbols on the $k+l$ work tapes, the transition of $M'$ at state $f(q)$ equals the left-block extension along $f$ of the transition of $M$ at $q$, using the first $k$ tape symbols. Then for every configuration $c$ of $M$ on Boolean input $x$ and every choice of contents and head positions for the last $l$ tapes, one step of $M'$ from the embedded configuration equals the embedding of one step of $M$ from $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ has $k$ Boolean work tapes and state type $S$
$M'$ has $k+l$ Boolean work tapes and state type $S'$
the transition compatibility condition holds for all $q$, input symbols, and work-symbol tuples
$c$ is a configuration of $M$ on Boolean input $x$
contents and head positions for the last $l$ tapes are arbitrary
replaced:
Let $M$ be a machine with $k$ work tapes and $M'$ a machine with $k + l$ work
tapes, both over the Boolean alphabet, and let $f$ be a map from the states
of $M$ to the states of $M'$ such that on every renamed state $f(q)$, for
every scanned input symbol and every tuple of scanned work symbols, the
transition of $M'$ is the left-block extension along $f$ of the transition of
$M$ from $q$ on that input symbol and the symbols scanned on the first $k$
tapes.  Then for every configuration $c$ of $M$ on input $x$ and all inactive
contents and head positions for the last $l$ tapes, one step of $M'$ from the
left-block embedding of $c$ equals the left-block embedding of one step of
$M$ from $c$; in particular a halted embedded configuration stays halted.
